newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower on NCD maturation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower on NCD maturation.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Thursday as market liquidity got a boost from the imminent maturation on Saturday of T$10 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.072 percent against Wednesday's 5.231 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.00 against 5.25. Dealers expected the rates to remain at a low level through the week.
In the bond market, the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.6300-5.6325 against 5.6575-5.6600 and the 10-year 86/1 bond yield was at 5.6500 against 5.6775-5.6800. -- Julie Hu(5080815)
